issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents(): The problem statement's UML (problem_statement.md) declares +getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (public), and the template contains a TODO for that method (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, TODO 2.4). The solution implementation declares the method as protected (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75). This inconsistency between the UML/problem description and the reference implementation can confuse students about the intended API and access level (tests or examples may expect the method to be public).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Prefer changing the solution implementation to public: in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java change the method signature from 'protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' to 'public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()'. Alternatively, if the intent was to keep it protected, update the problem statement UML and task text to reflect protected visibility so students are not confused.
